messages:
alex: hey @channel quick onboarding question — first day and my first CI run is stuck in 'queued' for pipeline redwood/frontend-ci. I installed the GitHub App and connected Buildkite but the agent queue is empty.
alex: Buildkite shows: "Registering agent... failed: 403 Forbidden (Installation access missing)". Pasting last lines:
```
2026-03-02T09:12:03Z ERROR: agent register failed: http 403 "Installation access denied"
2026-03-02T09:12:03Z INFO: queue size 0
```
alex: I also tried running a local bk-agent with my PAT: `bk-agent start --token $TOKEN` — token accepted but build doesn't pick up.
maria: welcome alex! :wave: Are you using the org-level GitHub App or a personal integration? Usually 403 = app not installed on repo or missing permissions.
alex: I clicked install during onboarding and selected the org. Not sure if I gave access to the repo. How can I check?
sam: run `gh api /app/installations` or check the org > Settings > Installed GitHub Apps. Also check Buildkite pipeline settings -> Repository access (should be 'GitHub App').
maria: also check the Buildkite Agent's register key if you're self-hosting agents. If using hosted agents, make sure the GitHub App has 'Contents' + 'Checks' perms.
alex: ok checking now... I see app installed but 'Limit access to selected repositories' is set.
alex: That would be it — repo not selected.
sam: Yep. Either add the repo to the app install or ask an org admin to change to 'All repositories'.
alex: Requesting admin via #people-ops, pinging @jordan for repo access.
maria: After that, re-run a trigger: `bk build schedule` or push a dummy commit.
buildkite-bot: Build scheduled #1234 for redwood/frontend-ci (branch: onboarding/fix)
alex: Build now started but failing in step 'install-deps' with permission denied cloning the submodule.
alex: Error: `fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': terminal prompts disabled`
maria: submodule URL is probably using https with auth. In CI we prefer SSH or use the Buildkite Git Clone plugin with `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
sam: For first-week quick fix, change submodule remote to git@github.com:org/repo.git or set `BUILDKITE_REPO` creds in pipeline env.
alex: Thanks — switching to ssh in .gitmodules and requeueing.
alex: ✅ Build passed. Thanks everyone! :tada:
maria: glad you got through. Logged a tiny onboarding doc note: https://redwood.example/docs/ci/onboarding#buildkite-github-app
alex: leaving note here: who do I tag for Buildkite access when I need a new pipeline? @infra-team or ping @sam?
sam: ping us in eng-infra or @infra-team; for production pipelines need a brief RFC but for dev pipelines we can do quick reviews.
ci-onboarding-bot: Tip: For agent registration errors, check app install perms and agent token scope. See https://redwood.example/ci-troubleshoot
